title: Total Recall
description: Recurring nightmares of the planet Mars lead a confused earthling into the center of an intergalactic conspiracy.

title: Universal Soldier
description: Dead soldiers from the '60s surface in the '90s as high-tech warriors reanimated by the U.S. government.

title: Super 8
description: A series of unexplained events follows a horrifying train derailment, leading some young filmmakers (Elle Fanning, Joel Courtney) to suspect that the catastrophe was not an accident.

title: The Core
description: In order to save mankind, scientists and astronauts must set off a nuclear device at the center of the Earth.

title: Event Horizon
description: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft.

title: The Time Machine
description: A scientist (Guy Pearce) travels into the future and meets a race of people who fear hideous monsters living under the ground.

title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
description: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.).

title: Collateral
description: A contract killer hijacks a cab and forces the driver to transport him to his assigned jobs in Los Angeles.

title: Flight
description: A veteran pilot (Denzel Washington) makes a miraculous landing after a mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground, but an investigation into the incident reveals that he was drunk at the time.

title: Dead Man Walking
description: A nun helps a double murderer deal with his actions and prepare for his execution in a New Orleans prison.
